reviews.no_findings_reason: The requested upstream update introduces no billing, tenancy or commercial policy change. Existing user-owned history remains protected by SPEC-002.
Existing FrankenSQLite-only new code, asupersync runtime and pinned dependency requirements are explicit in AGENTS.md and incorporated by SPEC-001 and SPEC-004.
Robot JSON goldens and native connector provenance already supply explicit compatibility checks under SPEC-002 and SPEC-004; no new protocol is proposed.
The update preserves the existing registry and storage/indexer/search boundaries; shared-file reservations and exact-path staging are explicit repository requirements under SPEC-002.
SQLite remains authoritative and search assets remain derived. No live archive migration is part of source integration; isolated migration acceptance remains required before completion.
